notes.title: THIS UPDATE CHANGES EVERYTHING - EVEN THE TITLE! ...WELL, THAT WAS (ALMOST) IT.
notes.notes:
Hey community,

I'm always on the move to enhance the gaming experience for "Eve Williams And The Secret Of The Trunk" (formerly "Cyber Noir Stories: The Trunk") and to take your feedback seriously. Today, I'm happy to share with you a comprehensive update that not only includes a significant title change but also a slew of improvements to make the game even better:

🎩 Title Change:

"Cyber Noir Stories: The Trunk" is now "[b]Eve Williams And The Secret Of The Trunk[/b]"! 🕵️‍♀️💼 Same gripping story, new name. Why? A little adventure in trademark land. But don't worry, Eve's already on the case! 🔍👾 Uncover the mystery with a new title.

🛠 Game Improvements:

[b]Footstep Fixes:[/b] I've improved the sound of footsteps to make them more precise and realistic.
Butterfly Effect Fixes: I've made corrections to ensure the consequences of your choices are more seamless and logical.
[b]Fix of Broken Destination Link in Warehouse:[/b] I've fixed a faulty destination link on the right side of the warehouse.
[b]Difficulty Level Adjustment for Chair QTE:[/b] I've tweaked the Quick-Time Event (QTE) for Eve's escape from the chair in the abandoned hospital, bringing the buttons closer together to lower the difficulty level and enhance gameplay enjoyment.

These changes are a direct result of your feedback and my continuous effort to make "Eve Williams And The Secret Of The Trunk" the best gaming experience possible. I am deeply thankful to you, Eve's passionate community, for your support and valuable feedback.

Your support is my drive. Let's dive together into the mysteries that Eve Williams and the mysterious trunk hold for us!

Best regards,

Your developer at PONY Entertainment

notes.title: Cyber Noir Stories: The Trunk RELEASE
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers and Detectives,

Get ready for the upcoming release of [b]Cyber Noir Stories: The Trunk[/b] on March 1st, 2024 on Steam – a game that blurs the lines between a classic point-and-click adventure and a decision-driven visual novel.

In the fictional city of New Cologne, you'll step into the shoes of Eve, a tough-as-nails private detective whose skill and choices will determine your path through this dark and captivating story. [b]Cyber Noir Stories: The Trunk[/b] offers you the unique opportunity to dive into a world where every decision counts and every interaction can influence your fate.

[b]**Key Features:**[/b]

- [b]Exploration and Interaction:[/b] Immerse yourself in Eve's world, explore your surroundings, and solve complex puzzles by cleverly combining items in your inventory.

- [b]Communication as a Tool:[/b] Use your communication skills to gather information, build relationships, and advance the story. The way you interact can shed light on the mysteries or lead to unexpected turns.

- [b]Inclusive Narrative:[/b] As an LGBTQ-friendly game, we welcome diversity and offer an inclusive experience that respects and celebrates a variety of identities and relationships.

- [b]Classic Look Meets Modern Narrative:[/b] Enjoy the perfect combination of classic point-and-click adventure design and the expressive, in-depth dialogues of a visual novel, all set in a cool comic style.

- [b]Action-Packed Moments:[/b] Quick time events add dynamism and excitement to the narrative, challenge your reflexes, and ensure a diverse gaming experience.

- [b]Multiple Endings:[/b] Your decisions carry weight. The Trunk offers a variety of possible endings – each choice counts and can steer the story in an entirely new direction.

We invite you to add [b]Cyber Noir Stories: The Trunk[/b] to your Steam wishlist and prepare for a unique adventure that you won't soon forget. Be ready to solve puzzles, make decisions, and uncover a mystery that lies deep in the shadows of New Cologne.

We look forward to welcoming you into the world of [b]Cyber Noir Stories: The Trunk[/b]. Add the game to your wishlist and be one of the first to experience this thrilling adventure after its release on March 1st, 2024.

Warmest regards,
Your developer from PONY Entertainment
